To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Internet control and data planes are tightly coupled in the sense that control plane routing anomalies and misconfigurations can be detected by analyzing data plane traffic and that the control plane can be used to detect and block persistent worms and other malicious traffic.

(1) persistent worms and other malicious data plane behavior are correlated with control plane routing anomalies and (2) control plane routing anomalies are correlated with misconfigured and mismanaged networks.

(i) the control plane is a rich and untapped source of information that could significantly enhance our ability to detect and filter data plane threats, and (ii) control plane anomalies are correlated with data plane anomalies and are a good proxy for detecting data plane threats.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use control plane information to detect, understand and filter data plane anomalies and vice-versa.
understanding the relationship between control and data plane anomalies in order to develop a more comprehensive approach to Internet-scale malware mitigation.
the question of how to leverage control plane anomalies to detect and filter data plane threats.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a clear need for the control plane to become more intelligent and more involved in the detection and filtering of Internet threats.
there are a large number of control plane anomalies that correlate with data plane anomalies and that these anomalies are not well understood or addressed today.

there is no silver bullet for Internet security, but that by combining the intelligence of the control plane with the data plane we can improve our ability to detect and filter malicious traffic on the Internet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the control plane is a rich source of information that could be used to enhance data plane filtering and that the control plane itself is vulnerable to attack.
we are trying to build an intelligence system that can help us detect the sources of persistent worms and botnets, as well as help stop them.
the Internet's control plane is not a pristine environment and the data plane and control plane should be treated together as a single entity when it comes to Internet security.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to start thinking about how to use the control and data planes in concert to better mitigate Internet threats.
we can significantly improve our ability to detect and filter malicious traffic by combining the intelligence of the control plane with the data plane.
the Internet's security problem is a control plane problem.
